mathematical_boundary: Smooth compact connected anticanonical divisor D in a complex surface, with D^2=0: full local unitary-flat neighborhood proof. Any nonempty compact smooth divisor with flat line near D admits a global smooth closed semipositive rank-at-most-one curvature. On compact Kahler surfaces its maximum rank is one and every fixed strictly positive smooth multiple has two-sided epsilon-order-one variational bounds, including nonclosed multiples. Nine successive blowups along smooth-cubic transforms, including infinitely near centers, have this curvature; the anticanonical line is semiample iff its elliptic normal line is torsion, with first moving basepoint-free multiple equal to its exact order. Non-torsion configurations exist and have only fixed positive systems. General P02 and unchecked global surface classification remain outside the result.

metadata.citation_title: Compact K\"ahler surfaces with semipositive anticanonical bundle
metadata.citation_abstract: We classify compact K\"ahler surfaces with semipositive anticanonical bundle. In particular, we resolve a question of Demailly--Peternell--Schneider: any blowup of $\mathbb{P}^2$ at 9 points on a smooth cubic has semipositive anticanonical bundle.
